silhouette.reason: Raised bat wings with finger bones, horned head, long neck and spiked tail on four legs: reads as a dragon from every view.
fixes: longer wing fingers so the wings read clearly as a flying surface in FRONT

proportions.reason: 4.9 × 2.8 × 3.3 m with the tail; the body and neck sit well, but the wings are small for a 600 kg flyer and the legs a little thin for the mass.
fixes: scale the wings ~25% in a Blender step so the span is plausible for the body

materials.reason: Image-to-3D texture reads as scales with cream belly plates and a lighter wing membrane; the horns are flat chalky grey and lighting is baked in.
fixes: repaint the horns with a keratin gradient (dark base to pale tip)

detail.reason: Scale texture, belly plates, claws and wing bones hold at third-person distance; the horns are blobby and the claws painted rather than modelled.
fixes: replace the horns with code-built ringed cones on the head bone

wear.reason: Some colour variation; no torn membrane, no scars or chipped horns.
fixes: a torn notch in one wing membrane and scars on the flank (seeded)

lod.reason: LOD2 (5k) is almost identical to LOD0 at the far view.
fixes: drop LOD2 to ~3k: the far view does not need 5k

technical.reason: QA PASS; 30k / 10k / 5k triangles, one draw per LOD; idle/look/walk clips, but the wings ride with the chest and never flap.
fixes: add a wing bone chain and a flap clip so the wings move
